left.raw_text: - Histology: Part 1: Metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) with histologic confirmation of adenocarcinoma. Adenocarcinoma with small-cell or neuroendocrine features is allowed. mCRPC is defined by prostate Cancer Working Group (PCWG)3 criteria.

right.raw_text: Part 2: mCRPC as defined above or pathologically confirmed metastatic renal cell carcinoma (RCC) as defined by world health organization (WHO) 2016 Classifications

left.raw_text: Part 1: Either measurable or evaluable disease for prostate cancer.

right.raw_text: Part 2: At least one measurable lesion as per RECIST v1.1.

left.raw_text: Evidence of disease progression on prior therapy that requires a new line of treatment

right.raw_text: Participants with accessible lesions enrolled in selected pharmacokinetic (PK)/pharmacodynamics (PD) cohorts and in Part 2 must agree to undergo the mandatory fresh tumor biopsies, unless collection of the biopsy presents a safety risk
